'''Keran Vondi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the gunnery officer of the ''[[Brentaal Star]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
If the player is a female Trooper in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', then [[Ava Jaxo]] invites [[Jorda Pell]] and Vondi to [[Ava Jaxo's apartment|her apartment]] along with the player; however, if the player is male, the player meets up with Jaxo alone.

If the Trooper chooses to save the prisoners at Colony A-77 at the cost of Agent Jaxo's life, the Trooper receives a message from Vondi with a companion gift.
